//: Capability manifest for <Navbar> (the .pc-navbar shell container) — svelte-pure-admin. See settings-panel.map.json / command-palette.map.json for the capability-only model. Navbar.svelte renders a fixed <nav class="pc-navbar {class}"> > <div class="pc-navbar__inner"> with conditional start/center/end zone snippets; the fit engine + nav-dropdown touch support are attached at onMount (RUNTIME), so the SSR shell has NO id/hook on __inner — the reason this fixture is capability-only (see navbar.json). The one shared SSR feature is the root class passthrough.
